_descriptions.enabled: When true, uses GMM-based zone detection to filter trades by fib zones
_descriptions.lookback_candles: Number of candles to look back from first_overlap_index for initial GMM window (window grows at each sweep)
_descriptions.timeframe: Timeframe for GMM zone detection (should match mid TF)
_descriptions.step: Price level granularity for GMM analysis
_descriptions.max_components: Maximum number of GMM components to detect
_descriptions.selection_method: 'elbow' uses elbow/knee method (finds diminishing returns point), 'min_bic' selects lowest BIC (may overfit)
_descriptions.fib_levels: Fibonacci levels to calculate within each zone
_descriptions.premium_zone: Fib range for premium zone (SHORT bias when price is here)
_descriptions.discount_zone: Fib range for discount zone (LONG bias when price is here)
_descriptions.allow_middle_zone_trades: When true, allows trades in middle zone (0.236-0.786)
_descriptions.take_profit_method: 'fib' uses 0.5 fib level as TP, 'order_block' uses existing OB-based TP

_general_descriptions.symbol: The asset symbol to analyze. Choose from asset_options below or use any valid Twelve Data symbol.

timeframes.high: Higher timeframe for detecting liquidity sweeps and overall structure. Options: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1h, 4h, 1day
timeframes.mid: Mid timeframe for Event B (BOS/IFVG) and validation. Should be smaller than high TF.
timeframes.low: Lowest timeframe for entry confirmation and trade execution. Should be smallest of all three.

_descriptions.sweep_proximity_threshold_percent: Percentage threshold for near-sweep detection. If price comes within this % of an inflection level, it counts as a sweep. 0 = exact touch required (default). Example: 0.5 means price within 0.5% of level counts as swept.
_descriptions.high_tf_lookback_candles: Number of high TF candles to include BEFORE the overlap period for better inflection point detection. These historical candles help identify price levels that may be swept during the tradable period. Default 300. Set to 0 to disable extended lookback.
_descriptions.use_fvg_trigger: When true, FVG respect on high TF also triggers Stage 1 (alongside liquidity sweeps). Bullish FVG respected = LONG entry, Bearish FVG respected = SHORT entry.

_descriptions.use_fvg_validation: When true, FVG respect is checked first and takes priority. If an FVG is touched/respected, validation triggers immediately without checking equilibrium.
_descriptions.use_equilibrium_validation: When true, checks if price enters the premium/discount zone (above/below equilibrium). For SHORT: trigger when price enters premium. For LONG: trigger when price enters discount.
_descriptions.require_fvg_in_equilibrium: OVERRIDES other settings when true. Requires an FVG that structurally overlaps with the equilibrium zone to be touched. This is the strictest validation mode.
_descriptions.abandon_on_new_sweep: When true, abandons current setup if a new liquidity sweep occurs during mid/low TF scanning. When false, continues building the current setup regardless of new sweeps.

_usage_notes.mode_priority: require_fvg_in_equilibrium takes precedence over the other two settings. When true, the other flags are ignored.
recommended_modes: FVG priority with equilibrium fallback: use_fvg_validation=true, use_equilibrium_validation=true

_descriptions.timeframe: Single timeframe used for 3-OB strategy. Should match one of the available TFs.
_descriptions.confirmation_timeframe: Lower timeframe for BOS/IFVG confirmation after OB-B retouch. Set to null or remove to use old green/red close behavior.
_descriptions.close_break: Require close/open break for BOS detection (true = conservative, matches Pine default).
_descriptions.min_dist_pct: Minimum distance (%) between OB A and opposite OB C to qualify a setup.

_descriptions.enabled: When true, runs backtest simulation on found signals. Set to false to only scan for setups without simulating trades.
_descriptions.initial_capital: Starting capital in USD for the backtest. Trades use full capital (compounding).
_descriptions.hold_overnight: When false (default), exits all positions at market close (intraday only). When true, allows holding positions overnight.
_descriptions.trailing_sl_enabled: When true, activates trailing SL after price reaches activation threshold, then continuously trails to nearest swing level on every candle.
_descriptions.trailing_sl_activation_pct: Percentage of entry→TP distance price must reach before trailing SL activates. E.g., 50.0 means trailing starts when price has moved 50% of the way to TP.
_descriptions.trailing_sl_swing_length: Swing detection lookback for the low TF trailing SL. Smaller = more sensitive (more swing points found).
_descriptions.min_profit_percent: Skip trades where expected profit (entry to TP) is below this percentage. Set to 0 to disable.
_descriptions.min_rr_ratio: Minimum reward-to-risk ratio (TP distance / SL distance) required to enter a trade. E.g., 2.0 means potential reward must be at least 2x the risk. Set to 0 to disable.
_descriptions.trend_filter_enabled: When true, uses ARMA analysis to determine market trend and filters trades against it. Bullish trend = only LONG trades. Bearish trend = only SHORT trades. Neutral = all trades allowed.
_descriptions.trend_filter_lookback: Number of mid-timeframe candles to use for ARMA trend calculation. Higher values = smoother/longer-term trend detection.
_descriptions.bos_1h_trend_filter_enabled: When true, filters trades to follow 1H BOS trend direction. Bullish 1H trend = only LONG trades. Bearish 1H trend = only SHORT trades.

_usage_notes.trend_filter: The ARMA model calculates a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR). If SNR < 0.05, trend is considered 'neutral' and no filtering occurs. This prevents false signals from noisy/sideways markets.
_usage_notes.compounding: Capital compounds after each trade. Wins increase position size, losses decrease it.
_usage_notes.exit_priority: TP/SL are checked first, then trailing SL (if enabled), then market close (if intraday only).

_descriptions.visualize: When true, generates an interactive HTML visualization of all sweeps with step-by-step analysis.
_descriptions.export_journal: Controls trade journal CSV export. Options: 'auto' (saves to results/trades/{symbol}_trades.csv), a custom filepath, or false to disable.

asset_options._description: Reference lists of available symbols organized by category. Use any of these values for the 'symbol' field above.
